stem:
Walia winds a coil of insulated copper wire around an iron nail and connects it to a cell to make an electromagnet. She brings the north pole of a small magnetic compass near end X of the nail, and the compass needle is attracted towards X. End Y is the other end of the nail.

What does this show about the two ends of the electromagnet?

options.text: End X is a South pole and end Y is a North pole.
End X is a North pole and end Y is a South pole.
Both ends X and Y are North poles.
Both ends X and Y are South poles.

teacher.key_rationale: Opposite poles attract, so the compass north pole attracted to X means X is South and Y is North. B reverses the poles. C and D treat both ends as the same pole.
